lifecycles._note: GSLB CRUD — LIVE-VALIDATED 2026-06-23 (10/10 endpoints 2xx). All 6 write ops + 4 read ops confirmed. Key facts proven live: (1) health_check_interval must be < timeout (e.g. 5 < 10); (2) health_check_probe_timeout must be 5-300 (use 5); (3) resources array must have at least 1 entry at create time; (4) resources[].region uses DASH format 'kr-west-1' NOT 'kr-west1'; (5) create/set-health-check/set-resources/set-routing-control all return 202 (ASYNC) — each leaves GSLB in EDITING state; must poll GET /v1/gslbs/{id} until $.gslb.state=ACTIVE before next SET; delete requires ACTIVE/ERROR state. Wait steps inserted between async ops. REGION GATE: GSLB only in kr-west1/kr-east1 — on a kr-south profile this lifecycle must be disabled. Status: all 10 catalog endpoints covered.

steps.name: wait-gslb-active
steps._note: GSLB create returns 202 (async). Poll until state=ACTIVE before attempting SET operations. Validated live: CREATING -> ACTIVE typically in <10s.

steps.name: wait-gslb-after-health-check
steps._note: set-gslb-health-check returns 202 (async EDITING->ACTIVE). Wait before set-resources which requires ACTIVE state.

steps.name: wait-gslb-after-resources
steps._note: set-gslb-resources may be async (EDITING->ACTIVE). Wait before set-routing-control which requires ACTIVE state.

steps.name: get-gslb-resources
steps._note: id-bound read of the gslb's connected resources (listgslbresources). Closes the gslb_id getid GET /v1/gslbs/{gslb_id}/resources. Keys off the create-captured gslb_id; tolerant [200,400,403,404] because on a 4xx create the id stays a placeholder (normalizes to the catalog '*' key, still records coverage). Complements the runtime probe-gslb-reads below — this explicit step also makes the endpoint statically reachable in a LIGHT run.

steps.name: wait-gslb-deletable
steps._note: GSLB set operations (PUT) may leave resource in EDITING state. Wait for ACTIVE/ERROR before DELETE, which requires those states.

lifecycles._note: 2026-07-08 완전성 편입(COMPLETENESS-AUDIT-2026-07-08, gslb gap 2/10: listgslbs + listgslbsregionalroutingcontrol). READ-ONLY verify lifecycle 신설 — networking-gslb-service(probe, 전 mutating tolerant)는 건드리지 않는다: 거기에 strict read를 추가하면 tolerant 비율이 0.5 밑으로 내려가 role 파생(HEAVY-PREMISE CONTRACT §1)이 probe→verify로 뒤집혀 placeholder-id 쓰기들이 2xx-target verify 레인에 유입될 수 있기 때문. 이 lifecycle은 mutating 스텝 0 → role 자동 verify. 전역 bare list만 담음(빈 목록 200도 실검증) — owner 규정상 placeholder-id read(404 노이즈)는 무의미하므로 id-bound read는 넣지 않는다. 두 endpoint 모두 live 200 2026-07-08 (빈 목록, 쿼리 파라미터 불요). REGION GATE(networking-gslb-service 노트 승계): GSLB는 kr-west1/kr-east1 전용 — kr-south 프로필에서는 이 lifecycle도 disable 필요; 현재 기본 env stage-kr-west1은 in-gate.
